summary: First-finish smoke test of FMS backend + frontend. All critical backend endpoints (public API, auth, OS CRUD, integrations, command-center, AI stub) pass. Frontend public home, CTAs, OS login, sidebar navigation to all 8 OS pages, integrations page (7 NOT_CONNECTED cards), Command Center (INSUFFICIENT_DATA revenue KPI + NOT_CONNECTED chips), and logout all work.
passed: GET /api/ returns FMS API metadata (name, version, location, ecosystem)
POST /api/public/newsletter twice with same email -> second returns {ok:true, already_subscribed:true}
GET /api/auth/me returns 401 without token, 200 with Bearer
OS endpoints (projects/artists/clients/bookings/integrations/command-center) return 401 without token, 200 with founder token
GET /api/os/integrations returns 7 adapters: frek_id, frekcore, freakansla, kora, cvln_wallet, cvl_brain, laurentia — all NOT_CONNECTED
POST /api/os/ai/ask returns adapter=laurentia, status=NOT_CONNECTED, answer starts with INSUFFICIENT_DATA
Public home: hero-title visible, all 8 French nav items present, hero-cta-book -> /booking, hero-cta-project -> /start-project
OS login with founder redirects to /os; Command Center shows INSUFFICIENT_DATA + NOT_CONNECTED
Sidebar navigation to /os/projects, /os/artists, /os/clients, /os/bookings, /os/ar, /os/leads, /os/integrations, /os/settings all render without crash
/os/integrations shows all 7 adapter cards (Frek-ID, FREKCORE, FREKANSLA, KORA, CVLN Wallet, CVL Brain, Laurentia) with NOT_CONNECTED status
notes: OS projects 'Type' select input is marked required with empty default ('—'). Browser validation blocks submit if not selected. Not a bug — expected UX. Backend accepts POST with only name (type defaults to music). Consider setting a default option in UI or removing the required attribute if desired.
Console 401 errors seen on OS pages are expected during auth transitions/logout and do not affect functionality.
